create_WalkingWrapper: create a WalkingWrapper instance that wraps a gym environment with a baseline quadruped locomotion controller
call_WalkingWrapper_step: call the WalkingWrapper step method with linear and angular speed actions to advance the robot simulation
call_WalkingWrapper_reset: call the WalkingWrapper reset method to reinitialize the wrapped gym environment and recreate the locomotion controller
review_WalkingWrapper_action_space: review the WalkingWrapper action space configuration that defines speed and angular speed bounds for the robot
refactor_WalkingWrapper_controller_setup: refactor the WalkingWrapper _setup_controller function to customize gait parameters like stance duration and duty factor
